tool_suggestions.title: Student Verification Monitoring Dashboard
tool_suggestions.prompt: Build a tool to monitor and manage student verification statuses across California universities, providing insight into pending and active verifications.
features: Overview of pending, approved, and rejected verifications with filtering by university
Detail view of individual student profiles with verification history and logs
Automated reminders for pending verifications to users and administrators
Search and filtering by demographics and university

tool_suggestions.title: Date Feedback Analysis Interface
tool_suggestions.prompt: Create an interface to visualize and analyze feedback from arranged dates, focusing on safety concerns and ratings.
features: Dashboard with aggregated feedback metrics and trends over time
Detailed view of individual date feedback, including safety concerns
Filtering and searching by university, date range, and rating
Export feature for generating reports on safety and satisfaction

tool_suggestions.title: Venue Performance and Engagement Tracker
tool_suggestions.prompt: Develop a tool to track and analyze performance data of venues for date arrangements, focusing on utilization and user ratings.
features: Dashboard displaying venue usage statistics and user ratings over time
Map view to visualize venue locations and performance comparison
Detailed venue profile with historical data on events and feedback
Alert system for inactive or low-rated venues requiring attention
